notes.title: Patch Note #3
notes.notes:
List of changes:
Lag compensation has been improved in high-ping matches.
Added 2 new pickup effects: Silence, Choppa.
Added improved statistics with detailed description of pickup effect.
Added V-Sync option in settings.
AI now has permanent "Silence" effect.
Small bug fixes.

notes.title: Patch Note #2 Singleplayer mode, effects combinations and more
notes.notes:
Hello! We are glad to present you our first major update! Take a look on the list of new features!

Effects combinations. We added possibility to combine effects from different pick-ups with each other! It means that from now on you can wreck your opponent’s gameplay even more. But remember that this rule applies to you as well. 
AI implementation. You asked – we delivered. We understand that some players can be dissatisfied because of the fact, that they can’t find opponent to play with in a quick match. But now even if you don’t have a friend to invite – you can easily test your skills by playing against AI opponents. They have 5 difficulty levels. And we warn you – the last one is completely unfair. Defeating him will prove your overwhelming skill level. Very few can do such thing.
Extended settings for session. Now you can change the pool of randomly spawned pick-ups. Want to play First Person Mode only? Or Active power-ups only? Maybe even no-pickups mode? It’s up to you now. 
Physics of the puck has been improved. It feels more responsive to hits, and gameplay is even more fast-paced than before!
Added overall graphics options.

Well, don’t hesitate – go and check this out! Share your opinions in discussions, suggest new features that you would like to see in a future updates, and, most importantly, HAVE FUN and ENJOY THE GAME!

notes.title: Patch Note #1
notes.notes:
List of changes:
Added "No pickups" mode, as requested. 
Added 4 new pickup effects: Strength Up, Strength Down, Halt, Obstacles. 
Changed visual appearence of a kick button. 
Fixed puck desync in some cases. 
Framerate is now capped at 120 fps.
